title: Notice Terms for Customer Reschedules of Installation Jobs
content:
**Customer terms — notice and the late reschedule fee on Installation Jobs**

How much notice a customer reschedule gave decides how the late reschedule fee base of an **Installation Jobs** record is turned into the notice-adjusted late reschedule fee. The late reschedule fee base is the amount of the late reschedule fee for that reschedule before its notice is taken into account. The notice is the whole hours of notice before 08:00 on the booked crew date recorded on the most recent customer reschedule of the job, the reschedule being charged.

## Clause

1. A reschedule requested with at least 24 hours of notice but fewer than the method's notice hours is pro-rated by the hours it fell short: the late reschedule fee base multiplied by the method's notice hours less the hours of notice given, divided by the method's notice hours, rounded to the cent.
2. A reschedule requested with at least the method's notice hours, when the job's customer reschedules (failed-access visits included) exceed the method's free count, is charged 40 percent of the late reschedule fee base, rounded to the cent.
3. A reschedule requested with fewer than 24 hours of notice is charged the whole late reschedule fee base.

The notice-adjusted late reschedule fee so found is the figure the reschedule is charged from.

## The method figures this clause turns on

| Installation method | Method's notice hours | Free count of customer reschedules |
|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 48 | 1 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 48 | 1 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 48 | 1 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 72 | 1 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 72 | 1 |
| Door System Installation | 48 | 1 |

The job's customer reschedules are counted over the job's lifetime up to and including the reschedule being charged, failed-access visits included.

## Hours-of-notice table (72-hour method)

| Hours of notice | Customer reschedules on the job | Notice-adjusted fee |
|---|---|---|
| 23 | any | the whole base |
| 24 | any | base times 48 divided by 72 |
| 71 | any | base times 1 divided by 72 |
| 72 | 2 | 40 percent of the base |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- 48-hour method, base 200.00, 30 hours of notice: 18 hours short, so 200.00 multiplied by 18 and divided by 48 gives 75.00.
- 48-hour method, base 175.00, 50 hours of notice, the job's second customer reschedule: 40 percent of 175.00 gives 70.00.
- 72-hour method, base 250.00, 10 hours of notice: the whole 250.00.
